§ 18.63 Requests for admission.
§ 18.63 Requests for admission.
(a) 
Scope and procedure
Scope.
(i) Facts, the application of law to fact, or opinions about either; and

(ii) The genuineness of any described documents.

(2) 
Form; copy of a document.
(3) 
Time to respond; effect of not responding.
(4) 
Answer.
(5) 
Objections.
(6) 
Motion regarding the sufficiency of an answer or objection.
(b) 
Effect of an admission; withdrawing or amending it.
